in_hebrew.name: אֲנֵנְעָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'ננה' (nun-nun-heh), which means 'to be gracious', 'to favor'. The name Aenneea can be interpreted as 'the one who is gracious', 'the one who favors', or 'the one who is favored'.

in_greek.name: Αἰνεία
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'αἴνις' (hainis), which means 'pain, grief, regret'. The name Aenneea can be interpreted as 'the one who is free from pain or grief', 'the one who is gracious', or 'the one who is pleasant'. The Greek form of the name is similar to the Latin name Aeneas, which is derived from the same root.

in_latin.name: Aenea
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'aeneus', which means 'bronze', 'copper', or 'shining'. The name Aenneea can be interpreted as 'the one who is shining with grace', 'the one who is gracious and shines', or 'the one who is favored and shines'.
